control_flow: avoidWalls: if RLIGHT is below 60 %, check the obstacle sensors (ahead: turn left 15°; else left: turn right 15°; else driveInTheDark); otherwise driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: In a dark tunnel, steer away from its walls: turn right for a wall on the left, left for a wall on the right, and get through a bend without touching it.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads below 60 % (the robot is well inside a dark tunnel)

branches.outcome: dim light: it looks at the obstacle sensors

decision_points.condition: in dim light: first, an obstacle is ahead; second, an obstacle is on the left

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it turns left 15°
no obstacle ahead, one on the left: it turns right 15°
nothing seen ahead or on the left: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it calls followLine

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light it turns right 15° when the left obstacle sensor sees a wall, turns left 15° when the front obstacle sensor sees one, and drives forward when it sees neither; it never reads the right sensor.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line in bright light that runs into a dark tunnel, the robot starts on the line before the tunnel, facing along it; in the dark the tunnel bends.
scenarios.trigger: In the dark, a tunnel wall comes close on the left or on the right.
scenarios.title: Steers away from the walls of a bending tunnel in the dark
assumptions: The tunnel bends in the dark part, and the robot gets there by following the line in the light.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It turns away from the wall that comes close, right for a wall on its left and left for a wall on its right, and gets through the bend without touching the tunnel walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It follows the line (curve left on black, right otherwise) and stops when the front obstacle sensor sees a wall.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line in bright light, either open ahead or with a wall across the line.
scenarios.trigger: The light stays bright; a wall comes in front of the robot.
scenarios.title: In bright light it follows the line and stops at a wall

scenarios.coded_response: It turns left 15° at 40 %, then looks again.
scenarios.initial_condition: In a dark tunnel, a wall stands across it ahead of the robot.
scenarios.trigger: The front obstacle sensor sees the wall in the dark.
scenarios.title: A wall straight ahead in the dark

uncertainties: You said to turn left for a wall on the right, but the program never reads the right obstacle sensor, so in a tunnel that bends left it drives on into the wall.
The program judges the dark differently on its two light sensors: the right one below 60 % and the left one below 70 %.
In bright light the program follows the line and stops at a wall, and you didn't say what it should do there.
In a bend the front sensor may also see the wall, and the program then turns left; whether that happens depends on the shape of the bend.
The robot only takes the tunnel for dark from about 10 cm inside it; before that it follows the line.
